records.linguistic_reason: Separate adjective and medical mass noun; sterile and concentration cannot be presumed for every saltwater solution.

proposals.gloss_en: containing salt or having a salty quality
proposals.gloss_zh: 含盐的；有咸味的

proposals.gloss_en: a sterile saltwater solution used for medical purposes
proposals.gloss_zh: 医用盐水；生理盐水

records.linguistic_reason: Replace misleading notion of one usage note standing in for the drug noun sense; no dosage or procedural information.

proposals.gloss_en: a feeling of intense happiness or delight
proposals.gloss_zh: 狂喜；极度喜悦

proposals.gloss_en: an informal name for the psychoactive drug MDMA, though street products may contain other substances
proposals.gloss_zh: 摇头丸；MDMA的俗称

proposals.gloss_en: Drug meaning is informal and should not be confused with the emotion sense
proposals.gloss_zh: 毒品义属非正式用法，不应与情绪义混淆

records.linguistic_reason: Distinguish adjectival umbrella descriptor from self-identification and social register, not a universal label.

proposals.gloss_en: relating to sexual orientations or gender identities outside heterosexual or cisgender norms
proposals.gloss_zh: 酷儿的；与性或性别多样性有关的

proposals.gloss_en: a person who chooses to identify with the term queer
proposals.gloss_zh: 自我认同为酷儿的人

proposals.gloss_en: Many people use queer affirmatively, but others dislike it; it has also been used as a slur, so respect individual self-description
proposals.gloss_zh: 酷儿常作肯定性的自我认同，但也有人不接受；该词曾被用作贬称，应尊重个人自称

records.linguistic_reason: Animal seasonal migration is prototypical; human migratory is context-dependent and should not imply seasonality universally.

proposals.gloss_en: moving seasonally or regularly between regions, especially of animals
proposals.gloss_zh: 迁徙的；定期迁移的

proposals.gloss_en: relating to migration of people or populations
proposals.gloss_zh: 人口迁移的；移居的

records.linguistic_reason: Separate noun and adjective and label figurative usage, avoid treating all widespread cases as medically epidemic.

proposals.gloss_en: an outbreak of a disease affecting an unusually large number of people in an area at a particular time
proposals.gloss_zh: 流行病；局部地区暴发的疫情

proposals.gloss_en: spreading rapidly and affecting many people, especially of disease
proposals.gloss_zh: 呈流行态势的；广泛蔓延的

proposals.gloss_en: Epidemic is also used figuratively for widespread social problems; distinguish this from epidemiological definitions
proposals.gloss_zh: epidemic可比喻社会问题泛滥，应与流行病学用法区分

records.linguistic_reason: Clarify false friend with repair and common plural reparations; historical meaning of restoration is not core beginner KU.

proposals.gloss_en: compensation or other amends provided for an injury or wrongdoing
proposals.gloss_zh: 赔偿；补偿；弥补

proposals.gloss_en: Reparations commonly refers to compensation for historical injustice or war damage; ordinary physical repair is usually repair, not reparation
proposals.gloss_zh: reparations常指对历史不公或战争损失的赔偿；一般物体修理通常说repair

records.linguistic_reason: Original wording conflated gender identity and sexuality; replace with broad accurate definition.

proposals.gloss_en: the sexual feelings, attractions, identities and ways of expressing them that are part of a person's life
proposals.gloss_zh: 性特征与性体验的整体；性倾向及其表达

proposals.gloss_en: Sexuality is broader than sexual orientation and should not be used as a synonym for gender identity
proposals.gloss_zh: sexuality比性取向含义更广，也不等同于性别认同

records.linguistic_reason: Clinical risk sense and figurative sense are not interchangeable; terminology needs sensitivity review.

proposals.gloss_en: having thoughts of ending one's own life or showing an intention to do so
proposals.gloss_zh: 有自杀念头或意图的

proposals.gloss_en: extremely likely to bring serious harm or failure, used figuratively
proposals.gloss_zh: 可能招致严重后果的（比喻）

proposals.gloss_en: In mental-health contexts suicidal describes a serious risk and must not be casually inferred from someone's behavior; distinguish figurative rhetoric
proposals.gloss_zh: 精神健康语境中该词涉及严肃风险，不能凭行为草率判断；应与比喻用法区分
